result:
I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and saved the grades to `grades/0001-s2.json`. Riley got 3 items correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Note |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | correct | The model only writes the tool request; the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | wrong (M6) | Riley chose "it will eventually fix the bug". A loop that repeats itself needs a stopping condition, such as a step limit. |
| q4 | partial (M4) | 4 is the right count. But Riley wrote that the model "runs" the tools itself, when it only requests them and the program runs them. |
| q5 | correct | The result goes back as the next input, and the model uses it to decide what to do next. |
| q6 | partial | Riley said the model picks a tool "by the name". It actually works from the full description: name, purpose and parameters. |

Riley has the loop and the request/result flow down. Two ideas still need work: the program, not the model, runs tools, and an agent needs a stopping condition.

I also added `learning-records/0003-quiz-0001-second-attempt.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. Submission s1 is still ungraded.

**Next step:** Write the description for `check_calendar` as the model would see it: what it does, its parameters and when to use it. Then say what should stop the loop if that tool keeps returning an error.
